steps: Identify the check and the use as TWO separate operations, and measure the gap between them.
Fire many parallel attempts (tens to hundreds) so at least one lands inside the window.
Vary ONLY the timing; the payload and session stay fixed.
Report a rate, not a single success: N successes in M attempts both proves the window and tells the reader whether it is practical to exploit.

steps: Establish that your out-of-band channel works AT ALL with a known true positive before drawing any conclusion from its absence.
